title: Set up the integral
text: The surface area is the integral of $$2\pi y \sqrt{\left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2+\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)^2}$$. Here this is the integral of $$2\pi 2t \sqrt{4t^2+4}=8\pi t \sqrt{t^2+1}$$ from $$0$$ to $$4$$.

title: Evaluate
text: With $$u=t^2+1$$, the integral is $$\frac{8\pi}{3} u^{\frac{3}{2}}$$ from $$u=1$$ to $$u=17$$, which is $$\frac{8\pi}{3} \left(17\sqrt{17}-1\right)$$.
